summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py and ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/summary.json; it follows the docs, including the stated factors 1 lb = 0.45392 kg and 1 oz = 0.02837 kg. The checker disagrees on every total_kg that involves lb or oz, and all counts, months and counters match. With the real factors (0.45359237 and 0.028349523125) the output matches the reference exactly. The doc and the reference conflict, so I kept the documented factors; the FACT table at the top of summarize.py is the only thing to change if the real ones are intended.
